title: Writing --- With A Clock
label: ch:ar-maa-al-saaa
canDo: I can produce Arabic writing at my own ceiling inside the target's twenty-to-twenty-five minutes, knowing that the test adapts to what I write.

payoff.summary: Complete AR-W03-maa-al-saaa: twenty minutes at the top of what you can actually do, rather than a rehearsed answer to a paper that does not exist.
payoff.note: The target is adaptive and reports a benchmark level per skill rather than a pass mark, so there is no fixed paper to rehearse and a weak answer lowers the ceiling of every question after it. The A1 claim is the project's own mapping, stated in the contract, not something the test awards.
